mapper.select: SELECT tenant_id, business_module_code, business_module_name, business_type, business_key, business_title, business_round, project_ref, project_name, action_path, data_digest FROM wf_instance WHERE id = #{instanceId} AND tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND deleted = 0
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO wf_lifecycle_event (id, event_id, tenant_id, instance_id, event_type, business_module_code, business_module_name, business_type, business_key, business_round, business_title, project_ref, project_name, action_path, data_digest, operator_id) VALUES (#{id}, #{eventId}, #{tenantId}, #{instanceId}, #{eventType}, #{businessModuleCode}, #{businessModuleName}, #{businessType}, #{businessKey}, #{businessRound}, #{businessTitle}, #{projectRef}, #{projectName}, #{actionPath}, #{dataDigest}, #{operatorId})
INSERT INTO wf_lifecycle_delivery (id, tenant_id, event_id, subscriber_key, status, next_attempt_at) VALUES (#{id}, #{tenantId}, #{eventId}, #{subscriberKey}, 'PENDING', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP)
